says: Today's tooling tests can reach process-signal laws through a local changed-test run because the host guard checks only integration and visual filenames.
proof: At the recorded head, vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --changed origin/main for a stepcommit.sh change completed stepcommit.test.ts and then started box.test.ts. The running child used lead/scripts run one with a box fixture. The run was canceled after inspection. box.test.ts:433-481 implements signalRun with real process-group SIGTERM and SIGKILL, and line 1886 calls it from a test. HOST_ONLY at vitest.config.ts:179 matches neither box.test.ts nor other plain tooling test filenames.
cost: A routine changed-test command can start process-signal checks on the laptop without reaching the guard for host-only tests.
